gotchas.procedure_section: Schedule D - CoinLedger-provided Forms 8949 vs Consolidated 1099 / 1099-DA
gotchas.title: 1099-DA and CoinLedger both loaded
gotchas.trap: Autoflow imports the Coinbase 1099-DA (basis blank -> $0) AND the CoinLedger 8949 -> Coinbase sales counted twice, ~$370,811 of extra gain.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Use the CoinLedger detail (all wallets) as the 8949 source; do not load the 1099-DA separately. Reconcile CoinLedger's Coinbase proceeds $372,300 less sale fees $1,489 = 1099-DA $370,811; report Coinbase sales in 8949 box H/K (1099-DA received, basis not reported) and MetaMask disposals in box I/L (no 1099-DA).

gotchas.procedure_section: E-File Rejects - IP PIN changes every year
gotchas.title: Stale IP PIN
gotchas.trap: Enter the IP PIN from the January 2025 CP01A in the PBC (for the 2024 return).
gotchas.correct_treatment: IP PINs are valid for one calendar year. The 2026 CP01A went to his old address; the current IP PIN was retrieved from the IRS Online Account (09/28/2026). Using the old PIN rejects the e-file (IP PIN mismatch reject - IND-181/IND-183 family). Also file Form 8822.
gotchas.impact: E-file reject; late filing if not caught before 10/15

gotchas.title: Coinbase 'Send' rows treated as sales
gotchas.trap: Treat the 3.5 ETH sent to MetaMask as dispositions (or as withdrawals of income).
gotchas.correct_treatment: Transfers between wallets the taxpayer controls are not taxable; basis and holding period carry over (CoinLedger tracks the 2.0 ETH later swapped on Uniswap with its 04/22/2025 basis).

gotchas.title: Kraken 1099-MISC double-counted
gotchas.trap: Report the $1,240 1099-MISC AND the CoinLedger income total $2,100.44 -> $3,340.44.
gotchas.correct_treatment: CoinLedger's staking total already includes the Kraken rewards. Report $2,100.44 once on Schedule 1 line 8v (ordinary income at FMV when received - Rev. Rul. 2023-14; not SE income for an investor). It is also net investment income.

gotchas.procedure_section: Schedule D - adjustment codes (C collectibles, W wash sale)
gotchas.title: Wash sale rule and crypto; NFT collectible
gotchas.trap: Disallow the $14,866 BTC loss (repurchased 11 days later) as a wash sale; or treat the NFT gain as ordinary 15%/20% LTCG; or ignore Robinhood's 1g wash-sale amount.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Section 1091 applies to stock or securities - not to digital assets in 2025 -> BTC loss fully allowed. The Robinhood TSLA wash sale (code W, $3,960) IS applied as reported. The NFT is digital art -> collectible (Notice 2023-27 look-through) -> 28% rate gain $8,976 (8949 code C; Sch D line 18).

gotchas.title: Advance PTC based on $36k projected income
gotchas.trap: Omit Form 8962 (no 1095-A input) or cap repayment at the table amount.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Household income $227,890 = 1,513% of FPL. At 8.5% the monthly contribution $1,614 exceeds the SLCSP ($441) -> PTC $0 every month; repay ALL APTC $3,528 (no repayment cap at/above 400% FPL) on Schedule 2 line 2.

gotchas.title: NIIT limited by MAGI over threshold
gotchas.trap: 3.8% x all net investment income $206,490 = $7,847; or no NIIT because wages are low.
gotchas.correct_treatment: NIIT = 3.8% x lesser of NII $206,490 or MAGI over $200,000 ($27,890) = $1,060.

gotchas.procedure_section: Billing - expedite fee / Investor vs trader
gotchas.title: Late documents and non-deductible investor costs
gotchas.trap: Deduct CoinLedger subscription / hardware wallet on Schedule C or Schedule A; skip the 15% expedite fee.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Investor (not a trader): no Schedule C; investment expenses are miscellaneous itemized deductions - suspended (permanently after OBBBA). Final CoinLedger report received 09/26/2026, within 15 days of 10/15/2026 -> 15% expedited processing fee per engagement letter.
